entries.1044bece94581071: A company that develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medicine products made by culturing patients' own cells, and also provides contract development and manufacturing for regenerative medicine and cultured human tissues for research.
entries.6e3d0b477ea78525: This business manufactures and sells regenerative medical products, made by culturing patients' own cells, for medical institutions. It has five products: autologous cultured epidermis Jeisu, autologous cultured cartilage Jakku, autologous cultured corneal epithelium Nepikku, autologous cultured oral mucosal epithelium Okyuraru, and autologous cultured epidermis containing melanocytes Jasumin. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,354 million.
entries.82e2d05664022002: This business provides contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) and contract development services (CRO) to companies, universities and medical institutions aiming to obtain approval for regenerative medical products. It also provides consulting based on the Act on the Safety of Regenerative Medicine and contract manufacturing of specified cell-processed products. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥546 million.
entries.a60306ef2c9ee1ad: This business develops, manufactures and sells the Lab Site series of research-use human cultured tissues (Epi-Model, Cornea Model and Epi-Kit), which are used in developing pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and other products as alternatives to animal testing. From the current fiscal year, the business has been renamed from its former name, 'Research and Development Support Business'. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥281 million.
entries.b040068464c766f1: Headquartered in Gamagori, Aichi Prefecture, the company develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medical products based on tissue engineering technology. It has no consolidated subsidiaries and operates on a standalone basis. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 200. It is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is a subsidiary of Teijin Limited. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales were ¥1,354 million for the Regenerative Medicine Products Business, ¥546 million for the Regenerative Medicine Contract Business and ¥281 million for the Lab Site Business.
